title: Crispy Polish Tofu Bowl
description: A delicious and easy-to-make dish that combines crispy tofu with polish flavors. Serve over a bowl with your favorite sides.
instructions: Cut the tofu into cubes and place on a plate.
In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, polish spices, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Dip each tofu cube into the flour mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Dip the flour-coated tofu into the yummy sauce, making sure to coat all sides.
Roll the tofu in the crispy breadcrumbs to coat.
Heat about 1 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
When the oil is hot, add the tofu to the skillet and fry until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the tofu from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the crispy tofu over a bowl with your favorite sides, garnished with carrot and onion slices.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
